notes.title: Graphics Settings & Checkpoint Improvements
notes.content:
Added graphics and display settings, including an option to limit the frame rate.
Checkpoints no longer reset to zero when a new player joins the server.
Added a popup hint about the option to return to the last checkpoint.
Minor bug fixes.

notes.content:
